title: Aftergraph Promotion Gates
description: EXPERIMENTAL promotion-gates contract for the Wave H verified-improvement slice. A production trace carries observation/correlation content only: promotion authority and promotion grants live outside the trace in gate/registry-owned stores and are referenced, never embedded. A trace is never a gate PASS by itself; routing/skill/workflow/model promotion moves only through gates plus registry evidence, and no challenger promotes itself. Trace/registry correlation is correlation only: correlation is never registry evidence and never promotion authority. Challenger traces inherit the Wave E EVAL binding (evaluators never score their own execution), not re-derived here. The trace confers no promotion authority. Production-trace characterization claims are evidence-gated on production evidence.

correlation_refs.description: platform-event-ref/0.1 correlation/provenance references composed by reference; possession never grants authority and correlation is never registry evidence.

gate_ref.description: Reference to the promotion gate owning the promotion decision; authority lives in the gate-owned store, never in the trace.

registry_ref.description: Reference to the registry-owned store holding promotion evidence; authority lives in the registry-owned store, never in the trace.

gate_evidence_ref.description: Gate-owned PASS evidence required before a trace is ever presented as a gate PASS.

registry_evidence_ref.description: Registry-owned PASS evidence required before a trace is ever presented as a gate PASS.

challenger_ref.description: Disposable challenger-candidate identity attached to the trace; a challenger never promotes itself.

executor_ref.description: Reference to the executor that produced the challenger trace.

evaluator_ref.description: Reference to the evaluator scoring the challenger trace; inherited Wave E binding requires it to differ from the executor.

claims_production_characterization.description: True claims a production-trace characterization; requires production evidence and is otherwise evidence-gated.

production_evidence_ref.description: Production-trace/model evidence backing a production characterization claim.
